selfIntersection.message: A required boundary curve crosses itself in both travel directions. Hidden connectors cannot repair this segmentation.

limitations: Floating-point chord-based intersection checks, not exact algebraic predicates.
Samples on a target cut within twice the geometry tolerance have no unambiguous colour and are counted separately.
Forward image sampling supplements the edge-parity and path-topology checks; it is not an exact area comparison.
Cut-error simulation and paper-core analysis are separate from this nominal validator.

materialCore.method: Guarded disk-centre lattice on the unfolded capsule. Four-neighbour connectivity; analytic outline and chord-distance refinement near threshold.
limitations: This replaces the Python GEOS offset implementation; numerical results are not identical.
Pass/fail concern this guarded discrete rolling-disk model, not stress or tear resistance.
Uncertain is not accepted by the strict material-core gate. Increase resolution to investigate.
Small tips and features below the explicitly stated area threshold are not certified.

visualReview.scope: All eight crop-producing annotation runs and their source/crop/mask/woven images; gold alternative trace; all six editable renderings.
observations: Blue/yellow crop includes lower/right fringe; checker cells survive but extra boundary slit remains.
Decorated checker and boar retain their main motifs in both bounds, with small contour/border irregularities.
Rabbit mask includes carpet fringe and selected fit deforms ears/body; all four diagnostic traces fail routing.
Gold upper-bound crop follows the heart more plausibly, but bright-gold classification remains imperfect. Alternative trace preserves angel and frame; some thin border arms remain asymmetric.
Hand-held patterned paper has classified flecks inside the cells; fitting loses six protected regions and remains rejected.

limitations: Reviewed unknown-pixel extremes are annotation-assisted diagnostics, not exact outlines, neural predictions, or deployable cropping improvements.
Six inspected development photos; no new fixed-31 benchmark gain.
Variant masks differ, so their errors cannot be compared as original-artwork errors.
Trace probe uses 2 seconds per sparse graph and up to 800 refinement steps; not a fresh automatic 10-second solve.
No original cutting paths or physical assembly validation.
